ops.title: Reviewed Codex broker passes native terminal smoke
ops.body:
Reviewed candidate dddcfb463919538a6bc67bd15fd2cf1b36bc92afa7b73b98debd8d498d3de36e passed fresh native TUI binding in a clean Terminal Control PTY, exact model response, persisted-thread Orca resume, exact Orca context restoration, and a fresh read-only approval roundtrip. The ordinary binding persisted only TERM and COLORTERM; the Orca binding retained the expected routing allowlist while excluding ORCA_OAUTH_TOKEN, ORCA_API_TOKEN, and ORCA_AGENT_HOOK_TOKEN.

A real installed native SessionStart hook ran through the reviewed wrapper and deliberately slept five seconds then exited 7; native Codex showed Hook failed but still completed the model turn. A separate pre-binding proof queued before resume, then generation 2 registration returned the successful native response before replay; the child received the final Orca context, the broker logged replay retained after exit 7, and the durable notification remained for retry.

One independent Orca automation finding remains: after the visible approval completed and FINAL_TRANSPORT_APPROVAL_ACK rendered, terminal wait still reported agent-interactive-prompt and terminal send rejected /quit as agent_prompt_blocked. Full evidence, the manual pending-marker limitation, and exact cleanup are attached from /tmp/codex-port-terminal-smoke-final.txt.
